results.title: Dawn Over the Han River
results.suno_sp: Chamber folk and orchestral pop arrangement. The instrumentation features a prominent solo violin playing a lyrical, folk-inspired melody, accompanied by a cello providing counterpoint and bass notes. A fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays steady eighth-note arpeggios. Orchestral strings provide sustained harmonic pads in the background. The piece is in 3/4 time, 110 BPM, in the key of D Major. The violin uses frequent vibrato and double stops. The arrangement follows an A-B-A structure where the B section features more dense string orchestration and higher register violin lines before returning to the intimate guitar and solo violin texture.

results.title: The Woodwind Garden
results.suno_sp: Operatic pop ballad with cinematic orchestral arrangements. Features a dramatic soprano female vocal with wide vibrato and classical technique. Instrumentation consists of a grand piano, a full string section including violins, violas, and cellos, a concert flute, and orchestral percussion including timpani and crash cymbals. The arrangement builds from a piano-led intro to a lush, symphonic climax. The tempo is approximately 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The strings perform legato melodic lines and tremolo textures during the bridge. The piano maintains a steady eighth-note arpeggio pattern throughout the verses. Orchestral swells and timpani rolls emphasize structural transitions.

results.title: Fanfare for the Forgotten
results.suno_sp: Orchestral march with a cinematic, celebratory character. The arrangement features a prominent brass section including trumpets, trombones, and French horns playing triumphant fanfares and melodic themes. A woodwind section consisting of flutes, oboes, and clarinets provides rapid scalar runs and counter-melodies. The percussion section is driving and rhythmic, utilizing a snare drum with crisp rudiments, orchestral bass drum, and frequent crash cymbal accents. A glockenspiel adds high-frequency melodic doubling. The string section provides a lush harmonic bed with violins playing soaring legato lines and cellos/basses providing staccato rhythmic support. The piece is in the key of B-flat major with a tempo of 120 BPM in 4/4 time.

results.title: Percussion Ritual
results.suno_sp: Bossa nova jazz with a light, playful arrangement. The lead melody is carried by a flute, often doubled or harmonized by a second flute. A nylon-string acoustic guitar provides rhythmic accompaniment with syncopated bossa nova strumming patterns. The percussion consists of a shaker, a woodblock or clave playing a steady pattern, and light hand drums. A clean electric bass follows the root-fifth movement typical of the genre. The tempo is approximately 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement features call-and-response sections between the flute and the guitar, with occasional staccato woodblock accents punctuating the phrases. The harmonic structure relies on major seventh and ninth chords.

results.title: Elegy in Amber
results.suno_sp: Orchestral cinematic score with a focus on woodwinds and strings. The piece features a prominent flute melody doubled by oboe and clarinet, supported by staccato string ostinatos in the violins and violas. A pizzicato cello and double bass line provides rhythmic counterpoint. The arrangement incorporates light percussion including triangle, glockenspiel, and subtle snare rolls. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The harmonic structure follows a classical film score progression in C major, utilizing sudden dynamic shifts and woodwind trills to create movement. The brass section, specifically French horns, enters during the climax to provide melodic reinforcement.

results.title: Sunlight Through Stained Glass
results.suno_sp: Gypsy jazz quartet featuring solo clarinet, acoustic rhythm guitar, upright bass, and accordion. The clarinet leads with chromatic runs and vibrato-heavy sustained notes. The acoustic guitar performs the characteristic la pompe rhythm, emphasizing beats two and four with percussive mutes. The upright bass plays a walking line primarily in quarter notes. The accordion provides harmonic counterpoint and occasional melodic fills. The tempo is 135 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of G major. The arrangement features a call-and-response dynamic between the clarinet and accordion over a steady swing foundation.

results.title: Double Bass Dreams
results.suno_sp: Chamber folk with a playful, rhythmic character. The arrangement features a pizzicato cello and violin playing staccato eighth-note patterns, accompanied by a flute that carries the primary melodic themes. A glockenspiel provides bright, metallic accents on the downbeats. The tempo is 110 BPM in 4/4 time. The piece follows an A-B-A structure where the A section is driven by the pizzicato strings and the B section introduces a more lyrical, legato flute melody over a steady, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming pattern. The key is G major. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the percussive nature of the plucked strings and the breathy texture of the flute.

results.title: Clarinet Noir
results.suno_sp: Bossa nova jazz quartet. The arrangement features a nylon-string acoustic guitar playing syncopated bossa nova comping patterns. A double bass provides a steady rhythmic pulse with a two-feel, emphasizing the root and fifth. The drum kit uses brushes on the snare, a closed hi-hat on every upbeat, and a soft kick drum pattern. A tenor saxophone leads with melodic improvisations, utilizing breathy tones and vibrato. The tempo is 128 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of F major. The structure alternates between the saxophone stating the head and taking solo choruses over the guitar and bass accompaniment.

results.title: Luce Notturna
results.suno_sp: Tango with a chamber ensemble arrangement. The lead melody is carried by a solo violin, characterized by frequent glissandi, dramatic vibrato, and sharp staccato articulations. A solo cello provides counter-melodies and low-register support. The rhythmic foundation is established by an acoustic piano playing marcato chords and syncopated bass lines. A woodblock or similar high-pitched percussion instrument accentuates the off-beats. The piece features sudden dynamic shifts between piano and forte sections. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time, with occasional rubato in the violin solo. The key is D minor.
